## Where to find it

Not found as loot.

- Crafted, see below.

## Crafting

**Made by**

- On the ground with a [Screwdriver](Screwdriver) (kept), 30 s: [Bucket](Bucket) + [Gas Cylinder](Gas-Cylinder) + [Motor](Motor) + [Power Supply](Power-Supply); taken down again with a [Crowbar](Crowbar) in 25 s, which gives the parts back

## Scrap

Cannot be scrapped: a Scrap Machine destroys it, see [Scrap](Scrap).
